blocks.text: QUEZON, Bukidnon — A 51-year-old man was arrested by police after he allegedly hacked his 58-year-old brother with a bolo during a heated argument over family land in Barangay 9 Poblacion here on Friday morning, November 27. According to the Quezon Municipal Police Station (MPS), authorities received a cellphone report from a concerned citizen regarding the hacking incident at around 10:30 a.m. Responding officers immediately proceeded to the scene and launched a hot pursuit operation, resulting in the arrest of the suspect.
